purpose: Separate coarse-structure repairability from late-detail repairability for the user-identified strawberry calyx displacement.

selection_boundary.reason: The endpoint and pred_xstart timeline were inspected to choose the mask and rollback times. This can test repairability but cannot validate autonomous detection or rollback selection.

arms.interpretation: Before the displaced green structure becomes a stable coarse object; tests coarse topology repair.
After the left-shifted coarse calyx is established but before the upright blade is fully sharpened; tests whether late resampling can change only detail or also attachment topology.

retention_and_judgment.primary_visual_question: Does the green calyx attach coherently to the fruit top without introducing a comparably severe new defect?
retention_and_judgment.secondary_visual_question: How much did fruit identity, pose, background, and non-target pixels change?
retention_and_judgment.required_report: Show and count all four localized attempts at each rollback time, alongside original replay and the full-fresh control; do not present only a successful attempt.

theory_guard: Localized attempts reuse the already observed baseline innovations outside the hard mask, so they are trace-conditioned hybrid suffixes, not fresh baseline-P suffixes. Conditional Ville retry and output-distribution bounds do not apply.
